query:
UPDATE dam_assets
              SET display_name = COALESCE($2, display_name),
                  tags         = COALESCE($3::text[], tags),
                  license      = COALESCE($4, license),
                  license_url  = COALESCE($5, license_url),
                  expires_at   = COALESCE($6, expires_at),
                  updated_at   = now()
            WHERE id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
